notes.title: Men of War II Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders,

The time that all the Men of War fans have been waiting for has finally come. As we're celebrating exactly 10 years since the full release of Men of War: Assault Squad 2, it is our utmost pleasure to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/]Men of War II is NOW AVAILABLE[/url]!

Watch the official trailer here:

[previewyoutube=2YdpMrNxIf0;full][/previewyoutube]

And just in case you have not heard about Men of War II yet, it is an anticipated sequel to the highly acclaimed Men of War franchise. It brings all-new units, locations, campaigns, game modes and true trademarks of the series: historical fidelity and action-filled gameplay on the Eastern and Western Fronts of WWII.

Learn more on the game's store page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/

There is no time to waste - if you buy Men of War II before May 22, you will get the Frontline Hero Pack DLC absolutely for free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4900810/c77a5896b2f8c83702dacf5c62f5001e2c77c463.png[/img]

You are most welcome to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/menofwarii]Men of War II Official Discord server[/url]. The worldwide community is waiting for you to join their forces and fight by their side!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/menofwarii][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4900810/a2b8491e3c2576de7a04c8197be3e99334e67e08.png[/img][/url]

Today also starts a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing/sale/menofwarfranchise]franchise-wide sale[/url] for previous Men of War games. You can get them all together in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12621/Men_of_War_Complete_Franchise_Bundle/]bundle[/url], where you'll get additional discount even if you already own some of the included games, or buy them separately. The choice is yours!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12621/Men_of_War_Complete_Franchise_Bundle/

notes.title: Men of War II Open Beta Starts Now!
notes.notes:
Commanders!

The time has come to lay your hands on Men of War II once again! The public Open Beta has just started and we are incredibly thrilled to show you what the game looks like now! If you have not done so yet, head to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/]Men of War II Steam page[/url] and request your access now.

If you were a part of the previous playtest, you will already have the game in your library, so you can jump into action immediately.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1128860/view/3729587725600669932][b]READ THE WHOLE ANNOUNCEMENT HERE[/b][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/

Please, take note that the game is still not finished, so if you experience any kind of bugs or experience-downgrading events, please, don't hesitate to report them to us here on Steam or preferably on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/cEKmM9yUQr]Discord server[/url][/b], where the community is active the most! Potential teammates are waiting there for you as well!

Also don't forget to add Men of War II to your wishlists, so you don't miss any important updates about the game.

Thank you very much for being a part of our community! No more talk now though, let's play Men of War II!


The playtest ends on [b]May 15[/b].

notes.title: Faces of War is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

notes.title: The entire Men of War franchise is now in a single huge bundle!
notes.notes:
Greetings, commanders!

You have now the ultimate opportunity to complete your collection and get yourself all Men of War games, expansions an DLCs that have ever been released!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12621/

Each of the installments is now a part of this huge Men of War bundle that you can get here on Steam right now! Furthermore, the whole bundle is discounted by 25% that add to the individual discounts (up to 90%) of each title! Even if you already own some of the games, the discount still applies to the games you don't have!

A perfect way to prepare yourself for Men of War II, don't you think? The sale ends on September 9.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/

notes.title: Men of War II Announced - New WWII RTS game coming 2022!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=6Y1zhLnZyO4;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings Commanders! We are happy to announce Men of War II, the anticipated sequel to the acclaimed RTS franchise published by 1C Entertainment and developed by Best Way!

Experience World War II like never before! Men of War II will bring all-new units, locations, campaigns and game modes, combined with the series’ trademark historical accuracy and action-filled gameplay on Eastern and Western Fronts of WWII. Stay tuned to experience the unforgiving heat of WW II battles first hand.

Wishlist MEN OF WAR II on Steam right now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/
